スープカレー.summary: A Sapporo-born curry with a thin, broth-like soup instead of a thick roux, loaded with large pieces of fried vegetables and a bone-in chicken leg. Most shops let you choose the soup base and spice level. Start mild if it is your first time.

ジンギスカン.summary: Hokkaido's classic: lamb or mutton and vegetables grilled on a dome-shaped iron pan, with the meat juices flavoring the vegetables around the edge. The smoke sticks to clothes, so use the apron most restaurants provide.
